review_candidates.title: Analog mixed signal design engineer
review_candidates.description_excerpt: Job Description The Analog Design and Circuit Technology team at MediaTek Egypt is searching for qualified candidates to join our fast-growing team. As a member of this dynamic team, you will get to work on state-of-the-art next generation wireline and optical transceivers for data centers serving cloud infrastructure as well as the growing field of AI and high-performance computing. Main Requirements and Qualifications Requirement : BSc and above with a major in EE or Physics related field.
